questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the purpose of “Data Import Fundamentals”?
options: Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.
Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.

Data Import Fundamentals should be treated as a repeatable data pipeline: define source and target contracts, normalize types, make duplicate behavior explicit, reconcile counts and samples, and plan retry or rollback before changing important data.
